summary: Merged the frozen T034 baseline with the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment into a single unified contract body at todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T034.md. Removed the top '> Contract status: FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778' marker and the '> Owner amendment (2026-09-16):' block. Restated the implementation unambiguously as T034 = data-quality and completeness reports with ADR-010 routing / budget / sampled A+B agreement qualification. Folded Decision 6 (five deterministic A+B required-sample rules with PoolId / partition bounds / EventKey / manifest-only selection, no RNG or wall clock; result-bearing requirement; per-run / per-partition / per-event-type / per-failover windows; complete=true only when all required samples agree AND no other gap / error / budget failure exists) and Decision 8 (infrastructure-correlation evidence enum unknown_not_proven / known_correlated / evidenced_independent with current state UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN; independent_provider_agreement wording forbidden; residual-risk callout required; state must not be blank) into Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not, and References. Added a final 'Binding direction reference' subsection that records the Owner decisions and the source path /tmp/owner_decision_T034.txt as an audit trail. Decision 5 frozen+amendment consolidation is honored: the Developer is forbidden from choosing only the old contract or only the amendment.
rationale: The triage classified T034 as CONTRACT_MISMATCH because the body carried FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778 plus a top-appended 2026-09-16 Owner amendment and was not executable as a single contract. Owner Decision 5 binding direction requires Planner -> Plan Reviewer to merge the frozen baseline and the amendment into a single unified contract body before any implementation begins. Decision 6 binding direction requires the five deterministic A+B required-sample rules (per run: chain ID / genesis hash / fixed-block block hash / PoolManager and StateView runtime code hash; per committed block-range partition: opening and trailing 10-block windows; per actually-observed event type: first 10-block window containing the smallest EventKey with duplicate-window dedup; per provider failover: pre/post 10-block windows with overlap-merge allowed and original-endpoint unrestored data staged-but-unqualified; result-bearing requirement when the dataset contains any events, with all-empty capability samples non-substitutable) and a deterministic-only sample-selection rule (PoolId, partition bounds, EventKey, manifest — no RNG, no wall clock) and gates complete=true on every required sample agreeing AND no other gap/error/budget failure. Decision 8 binding direction requires the infrastructure-correlation evidence enum (unknown_not_proven / known_correlated / evidenced_independent), the current state UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN, cross_endpoint_agreement-only phrasing, the must-not-leave-blank rule, the explicit residual-risk callout, and the documented non-blocking but must-surface property of UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN. This merge absorbs all three decisions into the contract body, drops the dual-layer expression, preserves ADR-002 / ADR-010 as accepted (no Spec or Intent layer is reopened), keeps T034 = data-quality and completeness reports, and adds the Binding direction reference audit trail at the end so the merged contract is one executable body.
